title: 793. Number of Subarrays with Bounded Maximum

examples.explanation: Seven subarrays stay within the upper bound and reach at least 2.

hints: Count subarrays whose maximum does not exceed a cap: scan once, extending the current run while values stay within the cap.
The answer for [left,right] equals count(max <= right) minus count(max <= left - 1).
Each position ending a valid run adds the length of that run to the total.
